amended.reason: Fixed two defects in my own tests. test_ac08_parity_vocabulary: its failure messages called bad_kind.get('kind')/bad_outcome.get(...)/bad_fx.get(...) eagerly as arguments to expect(), so when no bad event existed (the passing case) the f-string raised AttributeError on None; the assertions now format the offending event value directly. test_ac06_api_only_rejections: it collected the active-fight snapshots first and compared them only after H.write() had replaced the session for the no_battle cases, so the earlier 'refused request changed the file' comparisons were against a stale snapshot; each request is now checked immediately after it is posted. No thresholds or criteria were loosened.
